speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning information given the radiation to your jaw and arm, along with the sweating. Given the confirmed stress test and wall motion abnormalities, have you experienced any recent increase in the frequency or severity of these episodes with exertion?

text: Yes, Dr., the episodes seem to be happening more often lately. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (Unstable Angina/NSTEMI). The combination of exertional chest pain radiating to the jaw and left arm, associated with diaphoresis, and confirmed stress test results with wall motion abnormalities strongly indicates compromised coronary blood flow. Immediate cardiology consultation and likely admission for further management are indicated.
